name: PIR Motion Detector HC-SR501
description: Passive Infrared motion sensor with adjustable sensitivity (3–7 m) and time delay (5 s–5 min). Digital HIGH output on motion detection. Used for occupancy, security, and event-triggered logging.

signals.name: motion_count
signals.description: Cumulative motion event count since last reset

firmwareHint: Attach interrupt on RISING and FALLING edges for real-time detection. Allow 30–60 s warmup time after power-on.
